scope: Initial source-contract inventory across 75 lessons, shared feature comparison and a tested written Learning Guide pilot. It is not a full 75-lesson scenario or media audit.

shared_features.python: Seven-section written pilot for lesson 1 only.
shared_features.next: Review the lesson 1 pilot with a student; author and verify written guides for lessons 2?75.

shared_features.python: No packaged Python Learning Guide recordings.
shared_features.next: Author Python scripts and transcript/media manifests before recording; keep provider calls explicitly opt-in.

shared_features.python: Four manual checks, notes, challenge, two hints, saved attempts and 2–3 questions per lesson.
shared_features.next: Audit question/excerpt coverage; lesson 1's reference contract requires seven explained questions.

shared_features.python: Validated per-browser notes, attempts, quizzes, checks, preferences, progress export/import and guide positions.
shared_features.next: Continue corruption, reload and compatibility checks; do not claim cross-device account synchronization.

shared_features.python: Working learner and reference contracts: coach 7/7, evaluation 7/7, publishing 8/8.
shared_features.next: Provide separate reusable student starter templates without resetting completed applications or saved work.

shared_features.python: 75 Python host exercises and configured SDK profiles; one shared run form.
shared_features.next: Compare lesson-specific controls and observable behavior; inventory entries do not certify parity.

shared_features.python: MCP/browser/channel adapters and bounded repository fixtures.
shared_features.next: Finish native persistence, authenticated integrations and worktree/merge/recovery/PR workshops.

shared_features.python: Offline/browser tests and four OS/Python CI jobs; bounded live smoke evidence for selected surfaces.
shared_features.next: Fresh-machine/student trial, container verification, full accessibility review and explicit live integration gates.
